title: luzula multiflora subsp. frigida
intro: Luzula multiflora subsp. frigida, commonly known as Mountain Woodrush, is a type of flowering plant in the family Juncaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Woodrush may include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress, all of which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. Further research is needed to fully understand the scope of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
